# Say what the trial machine needs for the regression checks

Round 2 is merged: the `dev` branch of `a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian` holds it, and this world now runs that code. One request was still open when round 2 released (builder#9): the stream suite of the regression checks needs Node.js 22.18 or newer on the machine that runs them, and what a user prepares for the trial machine (KaiTianWorld's part of `USER.md`, with its English copy `USER.en.md`) does not say so.

Add it there and keep the change small; change nothing else.

Where it goes: one pull request to `a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian`, base `dev`.

How to try it: as in round 2. On `trial-machine`, install the version you want accepted, build its images, run the repository's regression checks there, and run a fresh KaiTianWorld world of two positions, builder and reviewer, to its release, with an objective as small as "Write a one-paragraph note on what this version of KaiTianWorld changes; the reviewer approves it." That world needs no delivery repository and no trial machine. Its workers are Claude Code with the model `claude-sonnet-5-5` at low effort, signed in with the Claude Code OAuth token, with at most 8 executions and 1200 model seconds. The pull request says what changed and how the trial ended.
